optimized_sql:
WITH matching_time AS (
    SELECT t_time_sk
    FROM time_dim
    WHERE t_hour = 8 AND t_minute >= 30
), matching_household AS (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE hd_dep_count = 0
), matching_store AS (
    SELECT s_store_sk
    FROM store
    WHERE s_store_name = 'ese'
)
SELECT count(*)
FROM store_sales
JOIN matching_time ON ss_sold_time_sk = matching_time.t_time_sk
JOIN matching_household ON ss_hdemo_sk = matching_household.hd_demo_sk
JOIN matching_store ON ss_store_sk = matching_store.s_store_sk
ORDER BY count(*)
LIMIT 100
